title: Hero Banner
description: The page banner: a full-bleed image roughly 680px tall on the homepage and 454px on inner pages, with a warm-dark scrim and the title block sitting left of centre on the content measure. The live pairing is a Joe Hand script line over an uppercase heading-face subtitle, both in base — see the Script Accent and Section Title heading styles. The scrim is neutral-900 at 45%, a step up from the 30% the archive cards use, because the banner carries text rather than just a label. Positioning of the inner text block stays with the pattern; this style owns the ground, the scrim and the type colours.

styles.css: & { position: relative; min-height: 454px; display: flex; align-items: center; } & > .wp-block-cover__background, & > .wp-block-group__inner-container { z-index: 1; } & .wp-block-cover__background { background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-900) 45%, transparent) !important; }
